capabilities: Design ERD diagrams with tables, columns, groups, and relationship cardinalities
Import schemas from SQL DDL, GraphQL SDL, DBML, and AML
Export DDL for eight databases, code in 22 languages and ORMs, and PNG/SVG
Manage logical and physical naming with word, term, and domain dictionaries
Let coding agents edit diagrams live through a local MCP server
extras: Desktop only; not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Makes no network requests or telemetry. Companion products exist as a web app with real-time collaboration, a Google Drive app, VS Code extension, and IntelliJ plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to design database schemas visually or convert them between SQL, modeling languages, and code.

relations.evidence: A coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex edits the diagrams in your vault through the ERD Editor MCP server.
